test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My mother said / that the thief / Ramesh will learnt / his lesson soon.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Ramesh will learnt .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence contains an error in the phrase **"Ramesh will learnt"**.
 
• The word **"learnt"** is the past tense or past participle form of the verb** "learn" **and cannot follow **"will"** because **"will"** is followed by the base form of the verb.
 
• The correct form is **"Ramesh will learn"**.

Correct sentence: *My mother said that the thief Ramesh will learn his lesson soon*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of "will":** In future tense sentences, the auxiliary verb **"will"** is always followed by the base form of the main verb.
 
• **Example:** She **will go** to the market tomorrow (correct).
 
• **Incorrect:** She **will went** to the market tomorrow (incorrect).
